qnxs-01.evidence: Deduced from open-space exits at this exact spot by four players: bartleby decoded the cipher on 08/11 at 10:47, flew in SLOW to stop exactly on Oc 5 / Rc 77 and left his vessel there at 16:06 with an intact hull; Horst (SOLT-10) exited at the same point 30 min earlier; MakerJay (SOSS-03) made the same precise approach on 11/11 and exited there on 11/11, 12/11 and 13/11; on 13/11 Horst came back and exited at 03:23, Roxy at 03:36 and again at 06:26. Roxy's two sweeps at Rc 77 and 82 on 08/11 got no reply.
